description: One reservation release request. draft-release writes it with the actor fields empty; release-reservation reads the same file after the releasing actor fills them.

reservation_id.description: The reservation_id that status --budget lists for the reservation.

actor.description: The person or agent releasing it: the reserving actor or the authority issuer. Empty in a draft.

evidence.description: The actual release decision. Empty strings in a draft.

reason.description: Why the unused reservation is released. Empty in a draft.
